extracted.intended_audience: independent production companies, producers and creatives seeking BBC commissions
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and opportunity notices for production companies and creatives pitching ideas or applying for BBC commissions, funds and development programmes across TV, radio, digital and online platforms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Minimum runtime (deepwatch documentaries)
rubrics_metrics.description: Each film will be a minimum of 25 minutes long.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applied to the commissioning of 20 standalone documentaries for the YouTube documentary channel deepwatch; proposals must meet this minimum runtime requirement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Target audience — deepwatch
rubrics_metrics.description: Aimed at engaging 16–24 year-olds across the UK.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Content should be tailored specifically for platforms such as YouTube and designed to engage the 16–24 demographic.

rubrics_metrics.name: Territorial eligibility — deepwatch
rubrics_metrics.description: Inviting production companies based in Northern Ireland, Scotland, Wales or the English regions to pitch their ideas.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only companies with a substantive base in these Nations/regions are being invited for this particular opportunity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number and standalone format (deepwatch)
rubrics_metrics.description: Commissioning 20 standalone documentaries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The opportunity is for 20 individual films (standalone), not multi-part series or serialised runs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Series format specification (comedy entertainment)
rubrics_metrics.description: Looking for a brand new and original format as a series of 10 x 30minute episodes that could be stripped across two weeks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Commissioning brief expects a defined episode count and duration and that the series can be scheduled (stripped) daily across a two-week period post-watershed for BBC iPlayer and BBC Two.

rubrics_metrics.name: Brand alignment and elevation (visualised podcast)
rubrics_metrics.description: The format should be inspired by the beloved BBC programme, encompassing the brand values and tone of the series but also elevating the experience to new heights.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should reflect the source programme’s brand and tone while offering fresh, elevated creative approaches appropriate to visualised podcast format across BBC Sounds and BBC iPlayer.

rubrics_metrics.name: Broad appeal and demographic engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: Ideas must have broad appeal and engage a wide range of audience demographics and age groups.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used explicitly for The One Show VTs and other opportunities; proposals should demonstrate potential to reach and resonate with diverse audience segments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Local/base requirement for commissions
rubrics_metrics.description: Suppliers must have an existing substantive base in the specified region (e.g., North East for The One Show VTs).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Certain opportunities require suppliers to be based in a particular nation or English region; briefs specify the required substantive base.

rubrics_metrics.name: Format-driven output (Our Lives documentaries)
rubrics_metrics.description: Invitation to pitch three standalone 30-minute documentary singles from suppliers based in the English regions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should be for 30-minute single films; supplier regional eligibility applies as stated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Target and tone for YouTube Perspectives channel
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop and produce formats focused on showcasing perspectives and encouraging dialogue and debate for 16–24 year-olds.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Content should prioritize debate and multiple perspectives and be suitable for the 16–24 audience on YouTube.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attention-grabbing / talkable podcast content (BBC Sounds)
rubrics_metrics.description: Podcasts targeting a new generation of listeners through headline-grabbing and talkable content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Commissioned podcasts should be designed to generate conversation and appeal to younger listeners; creative ideas should demonstrate 'talkability' and potential to attract attention.

rubrics_metrics.name: Live and highlights sports production capability
rubrics_metrics.description: Capability to produce the BBC’s TV coverage of cricket including international highlights of England home matches plus live coverage of the Hundred tournaments (contract 2026–2028).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Suppliers must demonstrate experience in producing both highlights packages and live sports broadcasts; invitations to tender include full eligibility and specification details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adherence to deadlines and submission windows
rubrics_metrics.description: Each opportunity specifies a deadline for ideas, initial submissions or applications (e.g., Deadline for ideas: 7 May; Deadline for initial submissions: 26 November 2025).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals must be submitted by the stated deadlines; different briefs have individual closing dates which must be followed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility for development/support programmes
rubrics_metrics.description: Development programmes and funds (e.g., Comedy bursary, Indie Funds, Factual Fast Track) have specific eligibility criteria such as being 'emerging' talent or based in particular nations and offer placements/mentors/grants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should check each programme brief for details; examples include paid shadowing opportunities, production mentors, £5k development grants, paid production placements and training.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emerging talent eligibility — Comedy bursary
rubrics_metrics.description: Comedy bursary scheme offering emerging writers, producers, directors and editors paid shadowing opportunities, production mentors and £5k grants to help develop new material.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Scheme is targeted at emerging practitioners; previous winners have received script commissions and production opportunities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Diversity and inclusion commitment
rubrics_metrics.description: BBC is committed to supporting the UK creative sector ... and baking diversity into everything we do.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Commissioning and development activity expects proposals and partners to align with the BBC’s commitment to diversity across people, stories and production practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distinctly British perspective
rubrics_metrics.description: The BBC commissions world class content with a distinctly British perspective.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Content is expected to reflect or speak from a recognisably British viewpoint where appropriate to the brief.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow editorial steers and audience insights
rubrics_metrics.description: Watch briefing events for the latest editorial steers and audience insights from commissioning teams (e.g., CBBC and CBeebies briefing).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposers should align pitches with the editorial priorities and audience insights shared by commissioning teams in briefings and published priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authentic homegrown stories from devolved Nations
rubrics_metrics.description: Increased investment will ensure more high-impact, quality programmes that tell authentic, homegrown stories from the devolved Nations to UK-wide audiences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Commissioning priorities include authentic representation of Nations’ stories for UK-wide distribution; producers from those nations are particularly encouraged.

rubrics_metrics.name: Service/platform-specific strategy and original content production
rubrics_metrics.description: Suppliers may be asked to develop and deliver a new strategy for digital video content on BBC Sport’s social platforms and produce original content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should combine strategy capability with demonstrable experience producing original digital/social video content appropriate to the platform audience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Opportunity-specific invitation to tender details
rubrics_metrics.description: Some opportunities are being put out to competition with a full invitation to tender to be published including eligibility criteria (e.g., Saturday Kitchen).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interested parties should await and consult the full invitation to tender for complete evaluation criteria and submission requirements.
